detail.longDescription: I had to crack open the plastic tupperware box my garden web server sits in, and bring the hardware bits and pieces inside for maintenance. Logging of boot and shutdown events has been broken since I changed the settings on my solar charge controller. The controller had an idea that the battery under its care was a lead acid battery instead of a LiFePo4 battery, and that it had strange and undesirable charging cycles. So it stopped distributing charge from the battery to the Raspberry Pi server, in a misguided attempt to lengthen the battery's life. To overcome this executive decision, I set it's battery mode to 'always on'. I think this broke my logging because my microcontroller was looking for a certain charge state to send a boot up signal to the Pi. Which the battery now never reports. So I updated the microcontroller code and reflashed it, then stuck the whole thing back in the box. Let's hope that will fix it... https:// uplode.org # solar # selfhosted # selfhosting # sustainability # raspberrypi # solarpunk
